recent_articles.title: Sulur minor girl abduction and murder: Law and order a serious concern in T.N., says Udhayanidhi Stalin - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Udhayanidhi Stalin**, leader of the Opposition, expressed concern over 30 major crimes within 12 days of the new government assuming office. recent_articles.title: After CM Vijay’s order to revive Amma Canteens, AIADMK hopes for comeback of other legacy schemes - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **AIADMK** functionaries have called for the revival and strengthening of several welfare schemes implemented during the party's previous tenures, including Amma Canteens, Amma Salt, Cradle Baby scheme, Amma Scooters, and 'Gold for Thali'. They also criticized the **Tamil Nadu** government's handling of government properties and alleged that several welfare programs initiated by the previous AIADMK regime have been discontinued or poorly implemented.  These criticisms were made during a meeting with the newly elected government led by **C. Joseph Vijay**.

recent_articles.title: DMK faces a challenge as allies set to join TVK government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DMK**, the Secular Progressive Alliance's leader since 2017, has lost most of its pre-poll allies.  The party is now left with only **MDMK** and **Manithaneya Makkal Katchi**, who contested on its Rising Sun symbol. Additionally, the DMDK remains loyal to the TVK government. The Congress abandoned the DMK after the Assembly polls and joined Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay's Cabinet on Thursday, while the IUML and VCK are expected to join the Ministry on Friday.

recent_articles.title: Historic shift: Vijay’s Cabinet marks Tamil Nadu’s best SC representation till date - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has appointed seven members from the Scheduled Caste (SC) community to his Cabinet. This marks a significant increase in SC representation compared to previous Cabinets.  Political analyst Stalin Rajangam believes this is a positive step towards inclusivity and sets a benchmark for future governments. However, Punitha Pandiyan, former Vice President of the Tamil Nadu SC/ST Commission, argues that celebrating this development trivializes SC politics.

recent_articles.title: 22 Ministers aged below 50: Cabinet signals generational shift in Tamil Nadu politics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Tamil Nadu government's Cabinet has seen a significant shift in age composition, with the 2026 TVK Cabinet featuring the youngest average age among the three governments examined.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of this government, is 51 years old and his cabinet features the youngest Ministers at just 28 and 29 years old. The 2026 TVK Cabinet has nine Ministers in their 30s, followed by a senior tier of seven Ministers in their 50s, three in their 60s, and only one in the 70-80 age bracket.  This contrasts with the 2021 DMK Cabinet which was heavily dominated by older leaders.

recent_articles.title: CM’s appeal to kids for votes: Plea in Madras High Court seeks an inquiry by Election Commission - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: DMK, AIADMK, Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, Election Commission of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A public interest litigation petition has been filed in the Madras High Court, seeking an inquiry by the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** into allegations of electoral malpractice during the 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly elections. The petitioner, L. Vasuki, argues that **Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay**'s appeal to children to vote for his party, Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), constitutes "exploitation of minor children for electoral propaganda" and falls under the definition of corrupt practice.  The petition also cites a representation by the anti-corruption organization Arappor Iyakkam alleging that **DMK** and **AIADMK** members distributed cash to voters in certain constituencies. The court has sought responses from the **ECI** and **CEO** by May 29, 2026.

recent_articles.title: T.N. Cabinet expansion LIVE: Congress set to join Tamil Nadu’s first coalition government in decades - The Hindu

Thirumavalavan**, leader of the VCK, and the **IUML** have been invited to join the Council of Ministers.

recent_articles.title: PIL plea filed against deposit of temple funds in State-owned non banking finance corporations - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: DMK boycotts floor test; urges CM to continue with Dravidian model welfare schemes - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Behind TVK Vijay’s rise is a generation drawn to “cinematic politics” amid a growing crisis of purpose - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Joseph Vijay**, leader of the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), won a significant number of seats in the recent Tamil Nadu election, capitalizing on a sense of restlessness and disillusionment among youth voters.  The victory was attributed to his ability to connect with young voters through a narrative of change that resonated with their desire for purpose and direction amidst routine life. This trend highlights the growing influence of social media and escapist entertainment in shaping political discourse and voter engagement, as evidenced by the TVK's successful campaign strategy.  However, critics argue that this "change" is superficial and lacks concrete solutions to address pressing issues like gender-based violence.

recent_articles.title: BJP targets DMK leader Udhayanidhi Stalin over Sanatana Dharma remarks - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: The legacy of women Ministers in Tamil Nadu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C. Joseph Vijay**, the new Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, was sworn in alongside **Keerthana**, who won from the Sivakasi assembly constituency, marking a significant milestone for women in state politics.  While social media erroneously claimed she was the first woman Cabinet member, women have served as Ministers in the Tamil Nadu Cabinet for decades, with the first instance occurring in 1946 under **T. Prakasam**. Since then, women have been consistently included in the state's Cabinets.

recent_articles.title: Election results 2026: Why welfare policies aren't winning polls in India like it used to
recent_articles.rephrased_article: India's welfare politics, once a key electoral tool, is facing challenges. While cash transfers and subsidized services have become the norm across parties, recent state elections suggest that extensive welfare delivery alone is no longer enough to secure incumbency.  **Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool Congress**, for example, lost power in West Bengal despite its women-centric welfare schemes. **The Bharatiya Janata Party** has capitalized on expanding welfare architecture, including women's self-help groups and administrative efficiency, while voters are increasingly demanding more than just welfare benefits.  Political scientists argue that this shift signifies a move from the floor of Indian politics to the ceiling, where parties must build coalitions around broader issues like job creation and economic mobility.

recent_articles.title: Floor test will be smooth; have received letters from EPS, Velumani factions: T.N. Assembly Speaker - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **J.C.D. Prabhakar**, the new Speaker of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly, assured that Wednesday's floor test will be smooth and successful. He acknowledged receiving letters from two rival AIADMK groups regarding the election of their Legislature Party Leader.  He plans to organize an orientation program for first-time legislators and will continue to follow established assembly conventions. **Prabhakar** expressed his confidence in the Chief Minister's majority and stated that he will oversee a smooth floor test. He has been involved in Tamil Nadu politics since 1972, serving as a legislator, secretary of the AIADMK, and later under **J. Jayalalithaa**.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay gives maiden speech in Assembly after TVK win - The Hindu

He congratulated **J.C.D. Prabhakar**, elected Speaker, and outlined priorities for governance, welfare, youth development, and transparency. The government also announced the closure of 717 TASMAC liquor shops within 500 meters of educational institutions and places of worship.

recent_articles.title: Why a ministerial vacancy nearly delayed Class 12 Board exam results in T.N. - The Hindu

After facing backlash from various stakeholders, including child rights groups and educationists, the department reversed its decision and released the results on May 8th, as scheduled. Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar urged the department to release the scores without delay.

Stalin** and **Gandhi**.  The TVK's success may bolster the Congress's influence in southern India.

Joseph Vijay, formed a government after securing the support of **Congress**, **CPI(M)**, **CPI**, **VCK**, and **IUML** parties, despite falling short of a majority.
